polygon-clipping 0.15.7 is vendored from its npm release:
https://registry.npmjs.org/polygon-clipping/-/polygon-clipping-0.15.7.tgz

Source: https://github.com/mfogel/polygon-clipping

polygon-clipping.mjs contains the self-contained minified UMD distribution,
with a local CommonJS export adapter and an ES module default export. The
source-map directive was removed. No CDN request or npm install is needed at
runtime. The upstream license and bundled attribution notices are retained.
